battle.name: 甄翟兒攻太原之戰
battle.brief: 大業十一年冬，河北起義領袖歷山飛的部將甄翟兒率眾十萬攻太原，前鋒擊敗隋將潘長文，圍晉陽數重。隋廷以右驍衛將軍唐公李淵為太原留守，與虎賁郎將王威、虎牙郎將高君雅將兵數千出城迎戰，於雀鼠谷陷入重圍。李世民率精兵突陣救出李淵，隋軍步兵趕到合擊，大破之，太原之圍遂解。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 交戰的一方是北齊與其縱容的河北叛軍。北齊都鄴，高緯在位，與隋朝在河北、山西一線對峙，倚重騎兵與關東豪族；但真正打到太原城下的並非北齊官軍，而是河北各處起義的群盜。通鑑記「歷山飛別將甄翟兒眾十萬寇太原」，可知甄翟兒是義軍體系中的統兵大將，十萬眾多為河北郡縣起義之後聚眾自保的部眾，步騎混雜、編制鬆散，糧秣就地徵集，並無穩固後方。另一方是隋朝，煬帝在位，太原郡是隋在河東的軍政、馬政與轉運中心，晉陽城屯有虎賁、虎牙等宿衛，郡兵與各府縣徵發的兵員編為守軍，倉廩儲糧由汾水沿線調度。作戰序列上，隋廷先遣大將潘長文出城迎敵，兵敗身死，隨後以右驍衛將軍唐公李淵接任太原留守，王威、高君雅為副將，率兵出城在雀鼠谷與敵決戰；北齊方面並未以大軍親至，攻太原的十萬眾實為叛軍，北齊朝廷在背後默許，藉此消耗隋的北方邊防。
countriesEn: The side that assaulted Taiyuan was Northern Qi together with the Hebei insurgents it indulged. Northern Qi, its capital at Ye, with Gao Wei on the throne, faced the Sui along the Hebei and Shanxi front and relied on cavalry and the great clans of the eastern provinces; but the force that actually reached the walls of Taiyuan was not a Qi army at all, it was a rebellion that had risen in the Hebei counties. The Zizhi Tongjian records that 'Lishan Fei's separate commander Zhen Di'er came upon Taiyuan with a hundred thousand men', which shows that Zhen Di'er was a massed commander inside the insurgent host: his hundred thousand were for the most part men who had risen in the counties of Hebei and then banded together to hold their own ground, infantry and cavalry mixed, organisation loose, grain taken from whatever the countryside could give, with no solid rear area. The other side was the Sui under Emperor Yang, with Taiyuan commandery serving as the military, stud and transport centre of the Sui in Hedong; the walls of Jinyang held huben and huya guards of the imperial household, and county troops together with levies drawn from the prefectures and counties were organised into the garrison, while the grain in the stores was moved up the Fen river. In the order of battle the Sui court first sent the general Pan Changwen out of the city to meet the enemy; he was defeated and killed, and the court then made the general of the Right Scarlet Guard, Duke of Tang, Li Yuan, the commander of the Taiyuan garrison, with Wang Wei and Gao Junya as his lieutenants, leading his men out of the city to give battle in the valley of Queshu. The Qi court itself never brought up a main army: the hundred thousand that stormed Taiyuan were in truth rebels, and the northern court acquiesced from behind, using them to wear down the Sui's northern frontier.
people: 甄翟兒是河北義軍領袖歷山飛的別將，統率十萬眾西進，在太原城下包圍隋軍數重。他的本名與出身在史籍中不詳，通鑑與北齊方面的記載都只以「甄翟兒」一名見稱；他率部眾自河北深入太行陘道，最後敗於雀鼠谷，此後生死下落並無明文。義軍領袖歷山飛才是這支軍隊的真正主帥，甄翟兒的十萬眾隸屬於他。隋方先亡的將領是大將潘長文，大業十一年四月他出城迎敵兵敗而死，太原防務因此空虛，朝廷改命李淵接替。李淵是唐國公、右驍衛將軍，以宗室宿將之望鎮守太原，所部只有數千人，副將為虎賁郎將王威與虎牙郎將高君雅。整場戰役的關鍵人物是李淵次子李世民，他率精兵殺入重圍，把李淵從數重包圍中救出，再與趕到的步兵合擊，反敗為勝。此外，隋煬帝楊廣下詔調兵、發糧，右翊衛大將軍宇文述卻奏稱盜賊漸少，內史侍郎虞世基把各地告敗的表狀壓下不報，納言蘇威直言盜亂逼近而遭貶官查勘，這些都說明此役的勝負不只在太原城下。
peopleEn: Zhen Di'er was the separate commander of Lishan Fei, the leader of the Hebei insurgents, and he led his hundred thousand west, enclosing the Sui army several times deep below Taiyuan. His personal name and his origins are not recorded: neither the Tongjian nor the histories of Qi give him anything beyond the name 'Zhen Di'er'. He led his men in from Hebei along a defile of the Taihang range and at last was defeated in the valley of Queshu, and no history says what became of him afterwards. The real commander of that host was Lishan Fei, and Zhen Di'er's hundred thousand belonged to him. The first Sui officer to fall was the general Pan Changwen, who was defeated and killed when he marched out of the city to meet the enemy in the fourth month of Dayi 11, leaving the defence of Taiyuan hollowed out and causing the court to hand the command to Li Yuan. Li Yuan was Duke of Tang and general of the Right Scarlet Guard, a kinsman of the imperial house and a seasoned commander, set to hold Taiyuan with only several thousand men under him, his lieutenants being the huben langjiang Wang Wei and the huya langjiang Gao Junya. The decisive figure of the whole affair was Li Yuan's second son, Li Shimin, who led picked troops into the encirclement, pulled Li Yuan out of the rings that surrounded him, and then joined with the infantry that came up to turn defeat into victory. Beyond the field, Emperor Yang Yang Guang issued the orders that moved troops and grain, while the commander of the Right Yiwu Guard, Yuwen Shu, reported that the bandits were growing fewer, the neixishi shilang Yu Shiji suppressed the reports of defeat coming in from the provinces, and the neiyi Su Wei was demoted and investigated for stating plainly that the disorder was drawing closer. All of this shows that the outcome of the battle was not settled only on the ground below Taiyuan.
kits: 本卡所配的羅馬標槍是共和末期羅馬軍團的制式投射兵器：槍身中空，前端裝鐵矛頭，尾部有套管與尾銷，槍手每手一具備戰，擲程約二三十步。它的妙處在於刺穿盾牌後槍幹即折，留在盾上的半截槍會令盾牌難以握持，也令中盾者無法把刺入的槍身拔出。相傳皮爾納會戰與坎尼之戰，羅馬步兵都曾以密集標槍雨覆蓋馬其頓方陣與迦太基騎兵的衝鋒。不過到六世紀，這件武器在原產地早已退場：三世紀以後軍隊普遍改用薩里沙長槍與較輕的短槍，標槍不再制式化，只在東羅馬與薩珊波斯交戰的戰例中仍可見成建制的投槍部隊。616年的太原城下，雙方實際使用的是弓、弩、長槍與刀，攻城依靠圍逼而非精巧器械，後勤靠牛馬車隊與汾水漕運。羅馬標槍在這場戰役中的位置是一個源流的位置：它代表的是以素質優良的投射兵配合精兵突陣、在密集陣前製造破口的戰術傳統，而雀鼠谷之戰正是這種打法的另一種版本。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on this card was the standard missile of the Republican Roman army: a hollow shaft with an iron head at the front, a socket and a spike at the rear, one carried in each hand by the skirmishing line, with a throwing range of some twenty or thirty paces. Its subtlety lay in the fact that the shaft broke on impact after piercing a shield, so that the half of it left standing in the shield made the shield hard to grip and left the man unable to pull the weapon free. Tradition credits the battles of Pydna and Cannae with dense volleys of pila covering the Macedonian phalanx and the Carthaginian cavalry. By the sixth century, however, the weapon had long left the stage in its homeland: after the third century armies had generally taken to the sarissa and to lighter short spears, the pilum was no longer a standard item and survived only in organised throwing companies in the campaigns of the Eastern Romans against the Sasanian Persians. Below Taiyuan in 616 the two sides in fact used bows, crossbows, long spears and swords; the siege was carried by pressure and encirclement rather than by clever engines, and the logistics rested on ox-drawn wagon teams and the Fen river. The position of the Roman pilum in this campaign is a position of ancestry: it stands for the tactical tradition of breaking an enemy formation with disciplined missile troops and picked infantry, and the fight at Queshu Valley is another version of the same thing.
tactics: 北齊方面的實際行動由叛軍執行。甄翟兒部眾自河北沿太行陘道南下，陘者，險隘通道，車馬不得縱行，進軍被壓成一條狹長的走廊；入晉陽地界後即分兵合圍，前鋒以騎兵衝擊隋軍出城部眾，試圖用兵力和圍壓迫使守軍消耗殆盡。隋軍這邊採取了不坐困城中的打法：李淵以數千之眾出城迎戰，把決戰地點選在太原城南、晉陽通往太行陘道的谷地雀鼠谷，打算利用谷道狹窄限制敵騎展開，再以弩兵齊射遲滯敵軍衝鋒。戰局卻因兵力懸殊而逆轉，隋軍深入谷中，反被十萬眾圍了數匝。李世民的解法是以精兵強行開路，直插敵陣之中，把李淵連同殘部拉出包圍圈；主力步兵隨後趕到，與精兵內外夾擊，圍攻圈在兩面受壓之下解體，敵軍當場崩潰。整個過程可以看見三個要點：以精兵破陣、以步兵完成合擊、以窄地限制騎兵衝鋒的展開空間。補給方面，晉陽城有倉廩可恃，援軍與糧械由汾水線接續；而深入山區的十萬眾糧道拉長，戰敗之後難以收攏殘部重新集結，這一點史書雖未明言，卻與戰後河北義軍重新整合的過程互相呼應。
tacticsEn: The actual operation on Northern Qi's side was carried out by the rebels. Zhen Di'er's host came south from Hebei along the defiles of the Taihang mountains; a xing is a narrow and dangerous passage in which cavalry and wagons cannot spread out, so the advance was forced into a single thin corridor, and once inside the Jinyang region they split up to encircle. The vanguard charged with cavalry against the Sui columns that came out of the city, hoping to grind the garrison down by weight of numbers and by the pressure of the ring. The Sui refused simply to sit inside their walls: Li Yuan took his few thousand out of the city to meet the enemy and chose the valley of Queshu, on the road from Jinyang towards the Taihang defiles, so that the narrowness of the ground would check the enemy cavalry from deploying and his crossbowmen could slow a charge with massed bolts. The plan was reversed by the disparity in numbers, however: the Sui column pushed too deep into the valley and was itself encircled several times over. Li Shimin's answer was to force a way through with picked troops, drive straight into the enemy host and drag Li Yuan and what was left of his men out of the ring; the main infantry then came up, and pressure from within and without broke the circle apart and the enemy collapsed on the spot. Three points stand out in the whole process: picked troops to break the formation, infantry to deliver the combined assault, and narrow ground to deny the cavalry room to charge. On the logistics side, the stores inside Jinyang could be relied upon and reinforcements and equipment came up the Fen river; but the hundred thousand who had pushed deep into the mountains had a long grain line behind them, and after the defeat had no easy way to gather their scattered men back together. The histories do not say this in so many words, yet it fits the way the rebel forces in Hebei had to be rebuilt afterwards.
data: 《資治通鑑》卷一百八十三記下這場戰役的幾個硬數字：甄翟兒「眾十萬」，是叛軍投入的總兵力；李淵「眾才數千」，出城迎戰的隋軍只有數千人，與十萬之眾相比，兵力差距至少十倍；「賊圍淵數匝」，說明包圍圈曾反覆合攏多次；結局是「會步兵至，合擊，大破之」，一句話交代了合擊扭轉戰局。時間上，大業十一年四月癸亥，甄翟兒首次寇太原，潘長文敗死；同年十二月，太原守軍在雀鼠谷與敵決戰，後世戰役表多把此役歸入大業十二年（616），因圍城與追擊延續到次年。戰場在太原城南通向太行陘道的山谷，距晉陽城不遠，是晉陽南面的門戶。背景數字亦可參照：隋朝先後三次征討高句麗，役前第一次出兵百餘萬，通鑑記死者什之五六，其後河北河南到處起兵，張金稱、郝孝德、高士達、竇建德、操師乞等名號遍布州縣；同年突厥入寇，詔李淵與馬邑太守王仁恭率兵拒之，兩軍眾不滿五千，可見河東方面可調用的精兵確實有限。
dataEn: The Zizhi Tongjian, volume 183, preserves several hard figures for this battle. Zhen Di'er 'with a hundred thousand men' was the total strength the insurgents put in; Li Yuan's host was 'only several thousand', so the gap between the two was at least ten to one; 'the enemy encircled Yuan several times over' says that the ring was closed and reclosed more than once; and the outcome is given in a single line, 'the infantry arrived, the combined assault was made, and the enemy was utterly broken'. As to time, in the fourth month of Dayi 11, on the guihai day, Zhen Di'er first fell upon Taiyuan and Pan Changwen was defeated and killed; in the twelfth month of the same year the Taiyuan garrison gave battle in the valley of Queshu, and most later lists of campaigns place this war in Dayi 12 (616), because the siege and the pursuit ran on into the following year. The battlefield was a valley on the road south of Taiyuan city towards the Taihang defiles, not far from Jinyang, the gateway on the southern side of the city. The background figures are worth setting beside it: the Sui had poured away its troops in three campaigns against Goguryeo, the first of which the Tongjian records as raising more than a million men with perhaps half of them dead, and afterwards risings ran through Hebei and Henan, with the names the Tongjian lists -- Zhang Jincheng, Hao Xiaode, Gao Shida, Dou Jiande, Cao Shiqi and the rest -- appearing across the prefectures and counties; in the same year the Turks came south, and the court ordered Li Yuan and the governor of Mayi, Wang Rengong, to march against them, the two forces together numbering fewer than five thousand, which shows how thin the seasoned troops available in Hedong really were.
cause: 這場戰爭是隋朝在三次征討高句麗之後把全國推向崩潰的過程中，被北齊利用的一場邊患。征高句麗耗盡了府庫與精兵，徭役與兵役隨之加到州縣，河北山東相繼出現張金稱、郝孝德、孫宣雅、高士達、楊公卿等部眾，江淮有操師乞、林士弘，關中與河東也不安；北齊朝廷對這些起義並非一味剿滅，而是藉招撫與默許，驅使叛軍去消耗隋的北方防線，自己坐收削弱之效。甄翟兒正是這樣被推到前台的：他的十萬眾雖是烏合之眾，卻是當時河北唯一能成建制出動的力量，而隋廷又正把主力放在對高句麗與西巡上，晉陽一線的守軍相對單薄。對叛軍而言，太原是隋在河東的支樞，取得晉陽就意味著取得糧源、馬匹與進入關中的跳板，於是決定傾巢兵力直取晉陽；而北齊與隋在北方的消耗戰，就在這條太行陘道上拉開了序幕。
causeEn: This war was a frontier trouble into which the Sui was drawn while the empire was being pushed towards collapse by its three campaigns against Goguryeo. Those campaigns drained the treasury and the manpower, and the corvee and the levies were then loaded onto the prefectures and counties; risings appeared one after another in Hebei and in the east, with Zhang Jincheng, Hao Xiaode, Sun Xuanya, Gao Shida and Yang Gongqing leading their bands, while Cao Shiqi and Lin Shihong held the south of the Yangtze, and the capital region and Hedong were unsettled as well. The Qi court did not simply exterminate these risings; it used pardon and acquiescence to drive them at the Sui's northern defence line, and sat back while the Sui was weakened. Zhen Di'er was pushed to the front in exactly that way: his hundred thousand were a motley, yet he commanded the only force in Hebei that could move in formed order, and the Sui court at that moment had its main strength committed against Goguryeo and against the western tour, so the garrison in the Jinyang area was comparatively thin. For the insurgents, Taiyuan was the hinge of the Sui in Hedong: to take Jinyang meant grain, horses and a springboard into Guanzhong, so they decided to throw the whole host into a direct assault on Jinyang. The war of attrition between Qi and Sui in the north opened there, on a road through the Taihang defiles.
impact: 此役的影響並不體現在太原的得失上，而體現在其後二十五年中原的走向。晉陽沒有陷落，李淵守住了河東的兵權、倉廩與名望，他隨後以太原為基地經營關中與山東的招撫，十七年後舉兵南下，終於代隋而有天下；如果616年冬天太原易主，李氏父子很可能就此被消滅，其後隋末群雄逐鹿的格局將完全改寫。叛軍十萬眾在雀鼠谷一戰崩潰，河北義軍受到重創，隋廷得以集中兵力對付竇建德與劉黑闥，換來數年的喘息；但同一場戰役也把隋朝制度上的病竈擺在檯面上：宇文述奏稱盜賊漸少，虞世基把告敗表狀壓下不報，蘇威直言盜亂逼近反遭貶官查勘，遠方軍情與朝廷判斷之間的通路已經斷裂。邊患無法及時上報、調兵遲滯，正是一個王朝在崩潰前夜最典型的徵候。對北齊而言，藉叛軍消耗隋廷的算盤落空，晉陽仍在隋手，北齊得以在關東維持對峙，直到北周在577年滅齊。
impactEn: The effect of this battle is not to be read in the fate of Taiyuan but in the course of the central plain over the twenty-five years that followed. Jinyang did not fall. Li Yuan held on to the troops, the stores and the standing of Hedong, and from Taiyuan he went on to work the connections between Guanzhong and the eastern plain, and seventeen years later marched out of the north and at last took the place of the Sui. Had Taiyuan changed hands in the winter of 616, the Li father and sons would in all likelihood have been destroyed there, and the whole pattern of the contest among the Sui's successors would have been rewritten. The hundred thousand rebels shattered in the valley of Queshu, the insurgent movement in Hebei was badly mauled, and the Sui court could concentrate its strength on Dou Jiande and Liu Heita and win itself a few years of breathing space. But the same campaign laid the Sui's institutional disease open as well: Yuwen Shu said the bandits were fewer, Yu Shiji held back the reports of defeat from the provinces, and Su Wei was demoted and put under investigation for saying plainly that the disorder was drawing nearer. The passage between what was happening on the frontier and what the court believed was already broken. The slow reporting of trouble and the sluggish movement of troops were the surest symptoms of a dynasty in its last night. For Northern Qi the plan of using the rebels to grind down the Sui had failed, Jinyang stayed in Sui hands, and Qi held the balance in the east until Northern Zhou destroyed it in 577.
result: 雀鼠谷一戰，隋軍合擊之下「大破之」，太原之圍解。甄翟兒率領的十萬眾在谷中崩潰，部眾或死或降或散，糧秣、馬匹與輜重按常例多為勝方所獲，通鑑未細載繳獲之數；史籍也沒有留下甄翟兒本人下落的記載，此役之後他便從通鑑的敘述中消失，其部眾日後重整，併入張金稱、竇建德、劉黑闥等河北勢力。隋方代價亦非沒有：四月出戰的潘長文兵敗身死，數千人的出城部隊幾乎全軍覆沒，太原一線的守軍元氣大傷，此後又不得不同時應付從馬邑南下的突厥，隋廷對北方的部署由此更加被動。戰役的直接結果是北齊方面十萬之眾一朝瓦解，太原得保；其深遠結果則要二十五年後才會顯現——正是因為晉陽仍在李氏手中，這場發生在太行山口的攻守逆轉，才成為隋末唐初的一段伏筆。史書以「會步兵至，合擊，大破之」十字記下了它的結局：步兵及時趕到這一件事，決定了太原的存亡，並最終決定了二十五年後由誰來收拾這片中原。
resultEn: At Queshu Valley the Sui army, after the combined assault, broke the enemy utterly, and the siege of Taiyuan was lifted. The hundred thousand led by Zhen Di'er collapsed in the valley; the men were killed, surrendered or scattered, and the grain, the horses and the baggage went for the most part to the victor as was usual, though the Tongjian records no exact figure for what was taken. No history records what became of Zhen Di'er himself: after this campaign he disappears from the narrative of the Tongjian, while the remnants of his host were reorganised and later drawn into the Hebei powers of Zhang Jincheng, Dou Jiande and Liu Heita. The Sui side paid a price as well. Pan Changwen, who marched out in the fourth month, was defeated and killed; the column of several thousand that went out of the city was wiped out almost to a man; the Taiyuan garrison was badly shaken and afterwards had to meet the Turks coming down from Mayi as well, so that the Sui's deployment in the north grew still more passive. The immediate result was that a hundred thousand men were broken up in a single day and Taiyuan was saved. The deeper result only became visible twenty-five years later: precisely because Jinyang remained in the Li family's hands, this reversal of attack and defence on a road through the Taihang range became a prelude to the end of the Sui. The histories sum it up in ten characters, 'the infantry arrived, the combined assault was made, and the enemy was utterly broken'. The fact that the infantry came up in time decided whether Taiyuan would hold, and in the end decided who would one day gather up the ruins of the central plain.
